title: 第一卷第17章 姬音澜第一卷第18章 我姓君不姓萧
content_zh:
;;
萧旭死了。
人们怔怔看着台上那血淋淋的尸体，一时回不过神来。
至死，萧旭都没能喊出认输两个字。
不是他不想说出这两个字，而是在剑意的压制下，他根本没有机会说出口。
“君无邪，你混账！”
萧家众元老气得浑身颤抖，面若死灰。
萧旭没了，一个未来有可能攀附上萧氏宗族天命者的人就这样没有了！
“君无邪，你竟杀了天命使者，令我大河剑宗损失了一名天才！”
契长老眼神冰冷，死死盯着台上的少年，垂落在腰间的手掌颤动，可怕的真气在指间流淌。
“契长老！”
吴大人脸色微变，感受到了他的杀意，忍不住提醒：“英才选拔赛已落下帷幕，君无邪才是夺得大河海选令的人。至于萧旭，一个死去的人，谈何天才？”
“此次选拔，不作数！”契长老咬了咬牙冷声说道：“本长老宣布，剥夺君无邪第一的资格！想要大河海选令？做梦！”
君无邪闻言，瞳孔微微一缩。
“契长老！”
吴大人怒视他。
“别这么看本长老！”契长老冷冷说道：“萧旭乃天命使者，与天命者有渊源的人，他于本宗的意义，便是一百个君无邪也比不了！”
“可清姐姐，他们为什么都要欺负无邪哥哥？”
小月瑶紧紧攥着秦可清的手，眼泛泪光，为君无邪遭遇的不公感到愤怒与委屈。
秦可清暗自叹息，不知如何作答。

“君无邪，跟本长老去大河剑宗领罪吧！”
契长老说着便要上台擒拿君无邪。
“契克夫，你区区一个外门记名长老，威风倒是不小。”
就在契长老登台时，一个微冷的声音在人群后方响起。
“姬元帅！”
城主汪诚转身的瞬间，顿时大惊，匆匆上前跪迎。
“臣，吴大佑，拜见三军元帅七公主！”
吴大人也吃了一惊，赶紧跪了下来。
“拜见七公主！”
人群自动分开一条宽阔的道路，而后齐齐跪下。
姬音澜骑着通体雪白的千灵驹来到比斗台前，冷冷看着契长老，道：“你是在仗势欺人还是徇私枉法？”
“七公主，我……”
契长老喉咙发涩，不敢看姬音澜的目光。
这个大周传奇，不仅是公主、还是三军最高元帅，听闻其身后的师门很不简单，他们宗门的高层都得给她几分薄面。
“现在，将大河海选令和聚气丹交予吴大人。”
“这……”
“嗯？”
姬音澜手中银枪遥指契长老，战枪嗡的颤鸣，一缕可怕的枪意瞬间将其锁定。
“我，我给！”
契长老一哆嗦，通体冰寒，枪意袭来，只觉得浑身每寸血肉都要裂开了，这种感觉让他极其难受，无比恐惧。

众人噤若寒蝉。
姬音澜！
如雷贯耳的名字！
content_en:
;;
Xiao Xu is dead.
People stared at the bloody corpse on the stage, unable to recover for a while.
Until his death, Xiao Xu could not say the word "admit defeat".
It's not that he didn't want to say these two words, but that under the suppression of the sword's will, he had no chance to say them.
"Jun Wuxie, you bastard!"
The elders of the Xiao family were so angry that they were shaking all over and their faces were ashen.
Xiao Xu is gone, and a person who may be able to cling to the destiny of the Xiao clan in the future is gone!
"Jun Wuxie, you actually killed the messenger of destiny, causing our Dahe Sword Sect to lose a genius!"
Elder Qi's eyes were cold as he stared at the young man on the stage. The palms hanging on his waist trembled, and the terrifying Qi flowed between his fingers.
"Elder Qi!"
Master Wu's expression changed slightly, feeling his murderous intent, and couldn't help but remind him: "The talent selection competition has come to an end, and Jun Wuxie is the one who won the Dahe sea selection order. As for Xiao Xu, how can a dead person be considered a genius?"
"This selection will not count!" Elder Qi gritted his teeth and said coldly: "I am announcing that Jun Wuxie will be deprived of the qualification to be number one! Want the Great River Sea Selection Order? Dream on!"
When Jun Wuxie heard this, his pupils shrank slightly.
"Elder Qi!"
Lord Wu glared at him.
"Don't look at me like this, Elder!" Elder Qi said coldly: "Xiao Xu is the messenger of destiny, a person who is related to the messenger of destiny. His significance to our sect cannot be compared to that of a hundred Jun Wuxie!"
"Sister Keqing, why do they bully Brother Wuxie?"
Xiao Yueyao held Qin Keqing's hand tightly, her eyes filled with tears, feeling angry and aggrieved at the injustice that Jun Wuxie had suffered.
Qin Keqing sighed secretly, not knowing how to answer.
"Jun Wuxie, follow this elder to the Dahe Sword Sect to receive your punishment!"
Elder Qi said that he was about to go up to the stage to capture Jun Wuxie.
"Chekhov, you are just a registered elder of the outer sect, but you are quite powerful."
Just as Elder Qi took the stage, a cold voice sounded from behind the crowd.
"Marshal Ji!"
The moment City Lord Wang Cheng turned around, he was suddenly shocked and hurriedly stepped forward to kneel down to greet him.
"Your Majesty, Wu Dayou, pays homage to the Seventh Princess, Marshal of the Third Army!"
Mr. Wu was also surprised and quickly knelt down.
"Meet the Seventh Princess!"
The crowd automatically separated into a wide road, and then all knelt down.
Ji Yinlan rode the snow-white Thousand Spirit Horse to the competition stage. She looked at Elder Qi coldly and said, "Are you bullying others or bending the law for personal gain?"
"Seventh Princess, I..."
Elder Qi's throat felt stiff and he did not dare to look at Ji Yinlan.
This legend of the Great Zhou Dynasty is not only a princess, but also the supreme marshal of the three armies. I heard that the sect behind her is not simple, and the senior leaders of their sect have to give her some slack.
"Now, hand over the Great River Sea Selection Order and the Qi Gathering Pill to Master Wu."
"This..."
"Huh?"
The silver spear in Ji Yinlan's hand pointed at Elder Qi from afar. The war spear buzzed and trembled, and a terrifying spear intent instantly locked onto him.
"I-I'll give it!"
Elder Qi shivered, his whole body was cold, and the gunfire struck him. He felt that every inch of flesh and blood in his body was about to burst. This feeling made him extremely uncomfortable and extremely frightened.
Everyone was as silent as a cicada.
Ji Yinlan!
A thundering name!
